# flickersofmajesty: what it can do, and how it got here

A fine-art photography dropship storefront (flickersofmajesty.com) of hand-written static HTML pages built on the FOM-Lite Protocol that makes listings readable by AI assistants.

## How we got here

Every change entry, newest first: what it was for, and what it made possible.

### 20261028-change-record-in-flickersofmajesty

Task `change-record-deploy-repos-20261028`.

**Why.** flickersofmajesty had no record of why its code changes: a commit message keeps what changed, not why it mattered, and the reason lived only in the memory of whoever made it. Ken asked on 2026-10-27 for the household change record in every repository, tuned to each.

**Enables.** Every commit here that changes the storefront's pages, styles, standards and admin tools now carries why it mattered and what it enables, judged when it is made, while changes to the product, collection and category listings alone need no entry.

**Untested:** This commit installs the gate here; the engine and this repository's tuning are tested in Project-Sophos, in admin/tests/change-record.test.mjs and admin/tests/change-record-deploy.test.mjs.
